title: nephrodium asplenioides subsp. sclerophyllum
intro: Nephrodium asplenioides subsp. sclerophyllum, commonly known as the Sclerophyllous Maidenhair Fern, is a type of fern native to Asia. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium asplenioides subsp. sclerophyllum include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
